runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium.
[[Webinar Sentinel]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Make sure all on-site Speakers have arrived. Greet them, mention time cue signals and the order of talks, and direct them to the [[Zoom Master]] for setup.
Make sure all remote Speakers have joined the Zoom Webinar. Greet them, and mention time cue signals (via Zoom private chat) and the order of talks.
Disable Zoom Chat for attendees.
runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: Promote [[Webinar Sentinel]], [[Q&A Producer]], and maybe backstage to cohost in the Zoom webinar.

For each on-site Speaker: help them install Zoom Client (if needed), join the Zoom Webinar and disconnect audio+video, and test screenshare and sound share. Then direct them to wait in the front row with their laptop, staying in the Zoom Webinar.
For each remote Speaker: test audio+video input+output, screenshare, and sound share. Then ask them to stay in the Zoom Webinar, muted and with camera off, until their turn.
[[Q&A Producer]] and [[On-site Session Chair]] agree on the Q&A signal.
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.
Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on laptop and disconnect audio+video. Keep both the Q&A panel and the participants view (for raised hands) open at all times.
Start the session. Introduce the first Speaker. Speaker starts. Sit in the corner of the stage with the [[Q&A Producer]].
If the Speaker is on-site, remind them of time elapsed.
If the Speaker is remote, remind them of time elapsed via Zoom private chat.
Organize and clarify the text questions arriving in the Q&A tool without interrupting the talk.
If the next Speaker is on-site, confirm they are in the front row, with their laptop still in the Zoom Webinar.
If the next Speaker is remote, confirm they are still in the Zoom Webinar.
When the talk finishes, start the Q&A. Pick the questions, balancing online VS on-site questions. Keep track of time; when time is up, end the Q&A.

When there is a clarified online question, signal the [[On-site Session Chair]]. If the Speaker is remote, also say it out loud, e.g. "We have an online question." When the [[On-site Session Chair]] takes it, read it / unmute the attendee and call him/her to speak up.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
When the Q&A ends, thank the Speaker. They stop screenshare; if on-site, they take their laptop back to the front row.
Introduce the next Speaker. If on-site, they bring their laptop to the stage and start screenshare. If remote, they unmute, start video, and start screenshare. Speaker starts.
If the next Speaker is remote, make sure they unmute, start video, and start screenshare after the introduction.

runsheet.time_info: If the next Speaker is not ready
runsheet.short_description: If the next Speaker is remote and not ready, walk to the side of the stage and tell the [[On-site Session Chair]]. Then help the Speaker get ready.

runsheet.time_info: If the next Speaker is not ready
runsheet.short_description: Move on to the following talk. Decide when the skipped talk is given later in the session.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the talks --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is caught, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the talks.
